Stable SDL3-CS release for SDL 3.4.18.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.18.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>` | `3.4.18.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Image` | `3.4.6.12` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Mixer` | `3.2.4.13` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.TTF` | `3.2.2.13` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Shadercross` | `3.0.0.13` |

## Changes

- Updated the core native baseline to exact upstream SDL `release-3.4.18` and exposed `PenDeviceType` on all five pen event layouts ([#314](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/314)).
- Aligned Front keycode/scancode and GPU/app metadata documentation with the stable SDL 3.4.18 headers; no SDL 3.6 development API is included.
- Rebuilt the full native matrix and the exact Android Java bridge; companion upstream versions remain unchanged.

Applications should update `SDL3-CS` and the matching core platform package to `3.4.18.0` and use the companion package revisions listed above.
